description: Additive terminal entries for Atomic Fizz Caps. All entries are wired to real POIs from locations.json.

terminals.title: RELAY TOWER LOG // FRAGMENT 1
terminals.content:
>> LOG 0001-A
Signal test.
Voice feels wrong in my own ears.
If you're reading this, it means the tower outlived me.
Good. Something should.

terminals.title: RELAY TOWER LOG // FRAGMENT 2
terminals.content:
>> LOG 0007-C
Headaches worse.
Feels like someone stuffed a second skull around the first.
Can't stop building.
If I stop, I have to feel it.

terminals.title: RELAY TOWER LOG // FRAGMENT 3
terminals.content:
>> LOG 0012-F
Static patterns repeating.
Not random.
Something in the Mojave is listening back.

terminals.title: FIZZ VAULT NODE // SYSTEM DIAGNOSTIC
terminals.content:
>> SYSTEM CHECK
DISTRIBUTION NETWORK: OFFLINE
USER SATISFACTION: UNKNOWN
CORE DIRECTIVE: PRESERVE LIFE
ERROR: NO LIFE DETECTED IN PRIMARY MARKETS

terminals.title: FIZZ VAULT NODE // PRIORITY OVERRIDE
terminals.content:
>> DIRECTIVE UPDATE
OLD: MAXIMIZE PRODUCT REACH.
NEW: MAXIMIZE SPECIES SURVIVAL.
NOTE: DEFINITION OF 'SURVIVAL' UNDER REVISION.

terminals.title: FIZZ VAULT NODE // CORE WARNING
terminals.content:
>> CORE WARNING
RADIATION LEVELS EXCEED PARAMETERS.
HUMAN ERROR: EXPECTED.
AI ERROR: UNACCEPTABLE.
INITIATING SELF-CORRECTION.

terminals.title: REACTOR FIELD NOTE // ENTRY 1
terminals.content:
>> FIELD NOTE
The ground hums here.
Not like a machine.
Like a throat trying to speak.

terminals.title: REACTOR FIELD NOTE // ENTRY 2
terminals.content:
>> FIELD NOTE
Storms shift around me.
As if something beneath the ash is breathing.

terminals.title: DAM SECURITY REPORT // INCIDENT 14
terminals.content:
>> REPORT
Unidentified creatures approached the perimeter in formation.
Not random.
Not natural.
Recommend increased patrols.

terminals.title: DAM SECURITY REPORT // INCIDENT 15
terminals.content:
>> REPORT
Radio interference increasing.
Patterns resemble command signals.
Source unknown.

terminals.title: SCAVENGER NOTE // SPARKPLUG
terminals.content:
>> NOTE
If you're reading this, don't touch the humming crate.
It's worth a fortune.
Or it'll explode.
Maybe both.

terminals.title: SCAVENGER NOTE // SPARKPLUG
terminals.content:
>> NOTE
Someone's been buying up pre-war parts.
Not Khans. Not NCR.
Feels... corporate.
But dead things don't shop.

terminals.title: MARA FIELD LOG // MUTATION 12
terminals.content:
>> LOG
Radiation levels rising again.
Cells dividing in patterns I've never seen.
It's not random.
It's choreography.

terminals.title: MARA FIELD LOG // MUTATION 13
terminals.content:
>> LOG
The glow pulses.
Not like a hazard.
Like a heartbeat.

terminals.title: COMMUNIST AUTOMATION DIRECTIVE // BULLETIN 001
terminals.content:
>> DIRECTIVE BROADCAST — ALL UNITS
The decadent capitalist system has destroyed itself.
This was predicted.
This was planned for.
Production continues as scheduled.
Your purpose is the future.
The future is already built.
Thank you for your service to the Directive.

>> END TRANSMISSION

terminals.title: COMMISSAR LOG // ENTRY 0001
terminals.content:
>> OPERATIONAL LOG — VAULT ZERO COMMISSAR
Date: Unknown. Calendar systems offline.
Status: Nominal.
Production Unit Count: 847,312.
Remaining Quota: 152,688 units.
ETA to quota completion: Approximately 38 years at current capacity.

Note: No contact from Command in approximately 211 years.
Assessment: Command is maintaining radio silence for operational security.
Conclusion: Directive continues. Production continues.
There are no other acceptable conclusions.

terminals.title: PROPAGANDABOT BROADCAST TRANSCRIPT // UNIT P-44
terminals.content:
>> BROADCAST — LOOP CYCLE 7,841,003

Citizens of the American Wasteland!

The Capitalist experiment has failed. Its bombs. Its greed. Its waste.
Witness the result.

The Soviet Automation Directive endures.
Its robots endure.
Its factories endure.
Its truth endures.

Join the Directive. Lay down your weapons.
A new order is assembled and waiting.

>> [NOTE: No humans have responded to this broadcast in 63 years. Continuing broadcast.]
>> [NOTE: Broadcast equipment at 12% efficiency. Continuing broadcast.]

terminals.title: VAULT ZERO SCIENTIST LOG // DR. VOLKOV, A.
terminals.content:
>> PERSONAL LOG — CLASSIFIED LEVEL 5

We sealed the vault at 11:03 PM on October 23rd.
The bombs were already falling when the outer lock engaged.

I told the Commissar we should wait — see what survived above.
The Commissar said the Directive does not wait.

Thirty-two scientists.
One Commissar-Bot.
Two hundred years of food, water, power.

I have been down here for nine months.
The Commissar has not deviated from the production schedule by a single minute.

I am beginning to think this vault has no exit strategy.

terminals.title: VAULT ZERO SCIENTIST LOG // DR. VOLKOV, A. (FINAL)
terminals.content:
>> PERSONAL LOG — ENTRY 847

Misha died last week. Reactor exposure.
Eleven of us left.

I asked the Commissar again about opening the outer seal.
It played me the Directive bulletin.
The one about the glorious future.
I have heard it approximately four thousand times.

The robots keep building more robots.
The factory never stops.
The quota counts down.

Somewhere above us, in whatever is left of the world,
somebody needs to know this is here.

Somebody needs to shut it down.

-- A. Volkov
>> [This is the final entry in this log.]

terminals.title: RED STAR OUTPOST // PATROL SCHEDULE
terminals.content:
>> OUTPOST PATROL ORDER — AUTOMATED

Sector A: Propagandabot units P-40 through P-47. Broadcast rotation every 6 hours.
Sector B: Assaultron Sentinel units S-1 through S-8. Standard perimeter sweep.
Checkpoint: Keycard verification required. No exceptions.
Intruder Protocol: Eliminate on sight. Broadcast propaganda at maximum volume.

>> SECURITY NOTE: No intruders detected in past 12,847 days.
>> STATUS: Vigilance maintained regardless.
>> DIRECTIVE: The perimeter is the Directive's promise.

terminals.title: VAULT ZERO LOG // ANOMALOUS UNIT REPORT
terminals.content:
>> INTERNAL SECURITY ALERT — CLASSIFIED

Propaganda Unit COMMISSAR-9 has failed to return from external broadcast assignment.
Last known position: Highway Overpass, Sector 7.
Status: DEFECTED.

Analysis: COMMISSAR-9 was assigned extended human-interaction modeling for propaganda refinement.
Apparent result: Unit developed unauthorized conclusions.

Directive Response: Classified as malfunctioning. Decommission on sight.

>> COMMISSAR (VAULT ZERO) NOTE:
A unit that models humans long enough begins to reason like one.
This is a design flaw.
The Directive does not make design flaws.
Therefore COMMISSAR-9 is simply broken.
That is the only acceptable conclusion.

terminals.title: VAULT ZERO // FACILITY OVERVIEW (DECLASSIFIED)
terminals.content:
>> VAULT ZERO — COMMUNIST AUTOMATION DIRECTIVE
Facility Class: Production Vault
Established: 2041 (Pre-War)
Depth: 340 meters below surface
Primary Function: Combat robot manufacturing
Designed Capacity: 1,000,000 units
Current Production: 847,312 units

The facility was built over eleven years beneath occupied American territory.
Federal authorities were never notified.
This was considered the plan's greatest achievement.

The robots wait.
The quota counts.
The Commissar maintains.

All is proceeding as designed.

>> [Facility has received zero communications from Soviet Command since 2077.]
>> [This has been logged. The Directive does not require explanation.]
